question: Why OpenHOI3's friends of a country whose province changes hands do not move that hour.

addresses.name: CAIStrategy_TellFriendsOfTheatres
addresses.no_signature: register convention: strategy in EDI, bare ret
addresses.comment: For each country of the strategy's country's non_hostile_countries (+0xF98) other than itself with an AI and controlled provinces: 0x48C090(tag, ai), which marks those of its unit agents whose theatre is reachable from ours to re-anchor. Bare `ret`, strategy in EDI. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-theatres.md, section H. **Read whole 2026-11-14** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 83): nothing unless our country's province_count (+0xD08) is at least 1; each friend must have its `ai` (+0x1D8) set and a province_count above nought. Seen in play: Barce passing from Italy to Britain on 17 July 1941 marked Bulgaria's and Iraq's theatre agents, whose full pass came that hour.
addresses.evidence: The listing 0x4AC390-0x4AC3FA read on the running game; the moves its marking sets off logged at CEU3AI::MoveUnit.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_MarkAgentsNearTheatres
addresses.comment: Called once, by CAIStrategy_TellFriendsOfTheatres (0x4AC390) for each friendly country with an AI, with **our** tag and **their** CEU3AI: each of their unit agents whose unit is level 0 gets area_dirty (+0x87) = 1 where any theatre of ours (CCountry +0x570) is connected (CTheatre_IsConnectedTo, rva 0xB0710: shares an area, or our headquarters can reach theirs) to that agent's theatre - so their next tick re-anchors. `ret 4`. The name is ours. **Seen in play 2026-11-14** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 83): the agent's theatre is CAIUnit::GetArea's (0x4BBAE0); every one of our theatres is tried, with no break.
addresses.evidence: The listing 0x48C090-0x48C12F read on the running game.

addresses.name: CTheatre_IsConnectedTo
addresses.comment: True when the two theatres share an owner area (their +0x84 lists hold a common COwnerArea), or else when both headquarters resolve (+0x74/+0x78 through FindPersistentByIdPair, less 8) and CMapProvince::CanUnitReach(other's headquarters' province, theatre's headquarters, true, true). `ret 4`. Three callers: CEU3AI_MarkAgentsNearTheatres (our theatre in EDI) and CEU3AI_BalanceDivisionsBetweenTheatres twice (the donor's theatre in EDI, the taker's pushed). The name is ours. **The reach is ours to theirs** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 83): CMapProvince::CanUnitReach is asked of their headquarters' province (+0x130) with our headquarters (the theatre in EDI's) as the unit, flags 1 and 1.
addresses.evidence: The listing 0xB0710-0xB07BF read on the running game.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::Tick
addresses.comment: **Slot 73, the whole of what a unit agent does each hour** (0x4B0730 to the bare `ret` at 0x4B0D17), settled on the listing. hour = (tick - 43800000) % 24, days = (tick - 43800000) / 24, dayOfYear = days - (int)((int)(days / 365.0) * 365.0); staggers A0 = id%24, A3 = (id+3)%24, A6 = (id+6)%24, A9 = (id+9)%24 off CAIAgent +0x38. In order: (1) area_dirty (+0x87), or hour 1 on a dayOfYear divisible by 7: SetArea(this, GetArea()); (2) hour A0 or stance_set (+0x80) clear: UpdatePlanAxis (0x4C3330); (3) a land unit: its plan's objectives copied into CArmy +0x2EC; (4) **slot 82 every hour**, flag = hour A0 on a dayOfYear divisible by 9; (5) hour A3: slot 85; (6) **no unit: return**; (7) hour A9: RebuildFocusOwnerAreas (0x4B0D20); (8) F ('full pass') = hour A6 or full_pass_pending (+0x84); (9) +0x368 = 0x4DCAE0(this); (10) **slot 78 when replan_subordinates (+0x86) or hour A9 or F**; (11) CAIUnit_UpdateThreatenedProvinces (0x4B1820) every hour; (12) F: slot 79 (ManageExpeditions); (13) F, or air_target_lists_built (+0x83) clear: BuildAirTargetProvinceLists; (14) slot 80 runs when hold_provinces_built (+0x82) is clear, or the threatened-provinces list (+0x1E4) is non-empty, or F and (day of month % 7 == 0 or runs_units clear); (15) F: where the unit is level 0 and the area id is set, CAIUnit_ComputePlanForcesAndPower (0x4B60F0) for a played country, else CAIUnit_ComputePlanForces (0x4B5210); (16) F, or (the country at war, in an undeclared war or with provinces in revolt, and hour % 3 == 0): 0x4CC450, 0x4D7F80, 0x4CC690 where the vector +0x10C is non-empty, 0x4CC020; (17) F: CAIUnit_PullHeadquartersIn; (18) where this is the nearest agent at or above its unit (CUnit +0x198 up +0x1E0): 0x4C4370(this, hour A6), CAIUnit_ManageAirUnits(this, F), CAIUnit_ManageNavalUnits(this, F or replan_naval +0x85); (19) CAIUnit_MoveAgentUnitToCommandProvince every hour; (20) F, or the same war-and-hour%3 test: CAIUnit_ManageLandUnits. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-agents.md, section A. **On a load** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 39, read live 2026-11-11 entering a save at Italy's own A6 hour): the agents made before the first of the two passes tick in it with no unit (+0x64 nought) and return at the unit test; the first pass binds them, and each runs its land block once, in the second pass, with full_pass_pending set. **A new game, logged 2026-11-12** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 56): its agents tick first at 01:00 with no unit and are bound at the end of that pass; the full pass, with the air body forced, is at 02:00 - as section 39 has for a load. **The full pass is asked after the area** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 83): `hour == A6 or full_pass_pending` is worked out at 0x4B09D2-0x4B09EA, after row 1's SetArea (0x4B08BE), row 5's slot 85 and row 7's focus areas, so an agent marked area_dirty has its full pass in the hour it sets its area.
